title: Tekko Prime
extract:
The Tekko Prime are the Prime variant of the  Tekko, sporting higher damage, critical multiplier, status chance, and attack speed. It was released alongside  Atlas Prime and  Dethcube Prime. Additionally, they gain increased status chance while wielded by Atlas.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance polarity has  polarity, matches  Seismic Palm and  Gaia's Tragedy stances.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest attack range out of all Fist melees.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On August 31st, 2021, it was announced that Tekko Prime, along with  Atlas Prime and Dethcube Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on September 8th, 2021. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.

Notes
As a Signature Weapon, Tekko Prime gains a bonus effect with  Atlas or  Atlas Prime, gaining an additional 6% base status chance, for a total of 32%.

Trivia
Tekko Prime is the first Signature Weapon with a signature benefit to be primed.
